## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` / `refactor` / `test`
- [ ] Breaking change (add `!` to the commit type)

## Checklist

- [ ] PR targets `dev` (not `main`)
- [ ] PR title is a valid Conventional Commit
- [ ] CI is green (lint, types, tests, security scans)
- [ ] Docs/ADR updated if behavior or architecture changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or `.env` committed
